assets.name: 余烬·双鱼
assets.detail: Palette crimson and ruby red with rose-red accents. Design a 'scarlet twin-fin' bow. Each limb has a long broad sabre-like leading ribbon and two short swept triangular fin surfaces that grow from it in a fluid fan near the shoulder; an inward narrow return blade forms a long tapered fish-shaped negative space. Strong clean slanted geometric transitions, not spikes or serrations. Center grip is a streamlined narrow diamond spindle; two asymmetric low crescent shoulder collars suggest two fish circling the palm, attached to the main body, no cage around the grasp. Bow tips have restrained V-shaped split tail fins integrated with string seats. Particles: a few red tiny chevrons and rose rhombus shards, drifting in opposing directions. Distinct angular yet fluid silhouette.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE beautiful original Pisces zodiac fantasy bow concept for a Skyrim solid-light weapon collection. Portrait 2:3 composition, ONE entire upright bow on pure black, full upper and lower tips in frame with breathing room. Near orthographic side view with a subtle three-quarter angle to reveal real thickness, bowstring one straight slender glowing line on RIGHT connecting both tips. Clearly usable compact handgrip centered, unobstructed arrow passage on string side. Physical structural continuity from grasp through both limbs to string endpoints; no floating structural pieces. Thick bevelled geometric bands and broad clean surfaces, elegant generous negative spaces and a few carefully designed facets. Material is solid colored magical light, saturated darker faces with slender luminous bevels and gentle restrained bloom; no overexposure. Abstract twin swimming fish, currents and tail-fin shapes, without literal animal sculptures. A small number of legible glowing particles close to bow limbs propose draw effects. Clean high-end game weapon concept illustration, no text, labels, logo, watermark, arrows, characters or environment. Avoid six-pointed stars, sigils, bulky mechanical hardware, brass, metallic filigree, engraved ornament, scales, chains of tiny repeated polygons, flimsy wireframes, disconnected fins, giant aura circles and smoke. Upper and lower limbs feel like one coherent balanced bow.

assets.name: 流萤·双鱼
assets.detail: Palette jade emerald green and turquoise mint. Design an elegant 'jade paired current' bow: the upper and lower limbs sweep in broad flowing S curves like two long fish moving toward each other. Each main limb is one smooth WIDE light ribbon with a single large teardrop-shaped open area bounded by an attached smaller return ribbon. At both shoulders the returns fold into soft rounded crescent lips, continuing into a narrow gently bowed palm with two diagonal light seams. Do not put a fan or star at the center. Slim tail tips flare into two modest joined petal-like fins. Sparse mint droplets and very small round emerald motes. A graceful sculptural flow, thick enough to feel substantial, airy open silhouette.

assets.name: 寒汐·双鱼
assets.detail: Palette deep cobalt and sapphire blue, cyan and pale turquoise bevels. Design 'twin tidal blades': TWO broad parallel curved blades along each bow limb, one long leading crescent and one shorter offset crescent nested alongside it with TWO visible short diagonal bridges. The inner crescent tapers into the leading blade before the tip, no detached ends. Large elongated narrow crescent negative space; outer edge is mostly smooth, not toothed. Center grasp is an oval faceted prism with a low flattened wave-shaped bolster above and below it; each bolster incorporates a broad curved triangular shoulder with a small off-center slit. Slender swept wedge tips, no giant fish tails. Sparse cyan hollow oval bubbles and sharp blue needle particles. A distinctly architectural aquatic design, stronger and wider than thin rings.

assets.name: 梦隙·双鱼
assets.detail: Palette indigo violet and lavender lilac, no red or pink. Design 'violet dreamfish': each limb is formed by two broad flowing ribbons that spiral around one another ONCE with clear depth and one large open eye-shaped space. They merge smoothly at shoulder and tip, with all parts structurally connected. Sweep the silhouette into a deep, elegant flowing recurve, not a straight helix. Near the grip two short, slender crescent tail-fins curl outward in opposing directions, rooted into the shoulder. The palm is smooth slender curved solid light with a single spiral luminous ridge that merges seamlessly into the shoulder ribbons; no separate cuffs, blocky fan or central ring. Both tip ends extend into graceful tapering crescent tails. Sparse little lavender crescent moons and small hollow diamond particles imply opposing streams of starlight. Soft sophisticated flowing silhouette.
